freezeProtocol: Blue-origin conversion of v1 synthetic scenarios, with explicit neutral-slalom clearance adjustment, frozen before new benchmark comparisons.

claims.allowed: Representative 2026 field maneuvers for reproducible planner engineering tests.
claims.prohibited: Do not describe this corpus as donated, real-team, competition-proven, or statistically representative of team strategy.

scenarios.intent: Exit the blue alliance zone through the scoring-table trench with a rolling endpoint.
Sweep from the blue alliance zone through the non-scoring-table bump under a lateral-acceleration limit.
Traverse a multi-bend neutral-zone collection line without touching an alliance barrier.
Mirror the trench exit on the red alliance side with a rolling endpoint.
Wrap below the blue hub and cross the scoring-table bump with constrained curvature.
Stop inside the neutral zone, wait, reorient, and continue on fixed geometry.

derivedFrom.transform: Mirror and rescale X into official meters; rescale Y; reflect headings and handles. No solver results used.
adjustments: Contract neutral-slalom X positions and handles 10% about midfield to preserve its neutral-only intent with the full-depth barriers and unchanged 0.84 m robot. Apply the same transform to its corridor gates. No timing target selected this adjustment.
